reader.requirement: PAGE-COUNTER is a reserved word naming a special register generated for EACH report of the Report Section (XIII-1 1.2.2: an unsigned integer holding at least 1 through 999999, usage implementor-defined); every RD has its own, qualifiable by report-name, and a program with no RD has none.

edition-consulted.switches: LINE-COUNTER / PAGE-COUNTER reserved at all four editions

reader.edition-search: Grepped Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior in CounterResolver.cs (only LinageFileOf consults Has(2014), not on this path), ReportWriterBinder#CounterExpr/#CounterPlace and AlgebraicRange#DescribeCounter (none); the ReportWriter LineCounter/PageCounter properties carry no edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: two reports in one program and cross-report qualification are covered; GLOBAL report counters in a contained program, the no-RD refusal, large values and integer contexts (subscript, COMPUTE, edited receiver) are not

probes.expected: one register per report, independent; 999999 representable; unsigned (MOVE -5 stores 5); usable as subscript and in arithmetic

probes.printed: COBOL2729 unqualified PAGE-COUNTER with more than one report description entry
probes.expected: refused (rule 3: qualify when more than one exists)

probes.printed: COBOL2729 LINE-COUNTER referenced, but the program has no report description entry
probes.expected: refused: a register exists only per report

probes.printed: COBOL2729 PAGE-COUNTER OF 'R9': the qualifier shall name a report description entry
IN LC=000002 IN PC=000001 (a contained program reads the GLOBAL RD's counters)
probes.expected: 1985 IPC: the counters of a GLOBAL RD are global names

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.5 GR1  (3.5.5 PAGE-COUNTER Rules)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: The register is the report engine's own field (one CobolReport per RD, EmitReportConstruction), reached by the one resolver CounterResolver#ReportOf in both directions; its implicit description (unsigned 32-bit) covers the 999999 the 1985 text requires. Nothing on the path consults the edition.

refuter.evidence: r2unpaged-001: an RD with no PAGE clause still has its own PAGE-COUNTER (PC=000001 after INITIATE, qualified with IN), SOURCE PAGE-COUNTER prints 000001; MOVE 999998 + ADD 1 gives 999,999, printed 999999. r2nolocal: a contained program with no RD referencing PAGE-COUNTER while the containing RD is NOT global -> COBOL2729 (no RD); r2nolocalq: PAGE-COUNTER OF R-G from it -> COBOL2729 (not a visible RD). r2shadow (RD GLOBAL outside, own RD inside): the inner unqualified counter resolved to the inner report (1), OF R-G to the outer (3) -- the X-22 IPC rule makes a GLOBAL RD's registers global names and the local one is not hidden by it. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.5.5 GR1; OK §1985:XIII.1.2.2; OK §1985:X.4.4.4 GR1.
